steps.content: This is a hidden basement in Eastside. The interior is installed with many invisible traps. They are not the usual physical mechanisms, but some kind of sinister, occult sorcery.
According to the 9th Agency, this is the evil means employed by the <color=#fb9259>Underground Mania power</color>.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Agent
steps.content: Expect the worst contamination. It'll be too intense on a Sinner. You'd better wait for reinforcements.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I can't wait any longer. The enemy may destroy the evidence anytime now.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I fought against a similar force not long ago. That Sinner used the same power. I'm certain this is where she got her sorcery from.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'll be breaking through and cleaning things up. Please cover me.
Rahu confirms the location of the suspicious room where a glimmer still flickers. She readies her weapon, steadies her breathing and mood. This kind of battle isn't even worth mentioning in the FAC.
